name_zh: 排放清单编制综合性能指数-核心版
name_en: Emission Inventory Compilation Performance Index - Core

D.human_observability: Unrecorded calculation-basis and control-process atoms in expert-led outputs are NA, not failures. Observable source, terminal, and exception decisions remain scored.

N.na_rule: Reference-value and internal-recalculation atoms are NA when their required observable values or process inputs do not exist; missing required output is scored once by result_completeness.

E.anchors: Empirical, source-class-specific seconds per record from Experiment A
E.invalid_anchor_rule: NA unless t_human > t_deterministic > 0 and t_method > 0

aggregation.run_repetitions: median score with min/max and pooled atom counts
aggregation.macro: equal arithmetic mean of INDUSTRIAL and POWER source-class scores
aggregation.micro_D_N: pooled passed/applicable atoms across source classes
aggregation.micro_E: expected target-source-count weighted mean across source classes

independent_reports.B1: Input-structure semantic retention; does not enter EICPI_core
independent_reports.B2: Controlled missing/conflict disposition, root-cause and unaffected-result diagnostics; does not enter EICPI_core
independent_reports.C: Scale/resource profile; does not enter EICPI_core
independent_reports.D: Ablation-specific D/N changes versus same-target Full; no ablation EICPI_core ranking

reference_interpretation: D and N quantify agreement with the frozen reviewed operational reference, not independent measurement truth.
